where: Umbral Spire ascent (gatehouse, null-works, high gallery)
mood: The Black Ascent: the climb through the dead Lumenary, null-lanterns leaking anti-light; relentless minor drive, all tension and no release.
core_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
driving pulse-wave lead with an urgent climbing minor melody
pounding plucked sampled bass in unbroken eighths
dark pipe-organ chords and tense string pad
eerie detuned high shimmer like light draining away
sampled march snare, timpani and tom fills pressing relentlessly forward

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {a sudden ominous organ chord and a rising drum roll, the bass locks into its pounding eighths and the shimmer hisses in high above, launching straight into the climb}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the climbing minor melody on the pulse lead, a bold rising leap that overshoots and keeps reaching, urgent and memorable over the pounding bass}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the melody again, now chased by the darting counter-line and fuller organ chords, the drums pushing harder}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: a grim sequence climbing through F and D minor, long held lead notes over stabbing organ, the detuned shimmer swelling like anti-light, building toward a dominant E}

sections.name: Climb
sections.text: {the bass and drums drive on alone for a moment with a tense ostinato, then the lead re-enters fragment by fragment, ratcheting fills mounting}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the climbing minor melody returns at full force; the last bar drives on E straight back into the main theme, tension held high}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
